- mise.toml: # Mise git commit generator Configuration
# Save to: $PROJECT_DIR/mise.toml
# Documentation: https://mise.jdx.dev/configuration.html
# Version: 1.0.0

# ============================================================================ #
# SETTINGS                                                                     #
# ============================================================================ #

[settings]
experimental = true                           # Required for advanced uv features
jobs = 8                                      # Parallel job count for faster installs
env_cache = true                              # Cache environment evaluations for speed
not_found_auto_install = true                 # Auto-install tools when entering directory
plugin_autoupdate_last_check_duration = "1d"  # Check for plugin updates daily

idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools = [
  "node",
  "python",
  "ruby",
  "go",
  "java",
  "yarn",
  "terraform",
  "packer"
]                                        # Read .nvmrc, .python-version, etc.

[settings.python]
uv_venv_auto = "create|source"  # create .venv if missing, then source (legacy true deprecated)

[settings.pipx]
uvx = true  # Use uvx instead of pipx

[env]
PYTHONPATH = "src"
HK_LOG = "trace"
HK_MISE = "1"
HK_LOG_FILE = "logs/hk.log"

# ============================================================================ #
# TOOLS                                                                        #
# ============================================================================ #

[tools]
fnox = "1.25.0"                # Hybrid secrets orchestration
age = "1.3.1"                  # File encryption fallback for fnox
gum = "0.17.0"                 # Terminal-native TUI for interactive git-cg review
hk = "1.51.0"                  # git hook manager (https://github.com/jdx/hk) (https://hk.jdx.dev/) — exact pin aligned with hk.pkl amend
pkl = "0.31.1"                 # embeddable configuration language (https://pkl-lang.org)
python = "3.14"                # Python runtime (https://python.org)
usage = "3.3.0"                # Usage is a spec and CLI for defining CLI tools. (https://github.com/jdx/usage) (https://usage.jdx.dev/)
uv = "0.11.26"                 # Fast Python package and environment manager (https://uv.astral.sh)
rtk = "0.43.0"                 # High-performance CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% (https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk)
node = "24.15.0"               # JS runtime for validation hook (https://nodejs.org)
# "npm:promptfoo" = "0.121.17"             # Moved to Brewfile due to Node shimming conflicts
just = "1.51.0"                # Task runner for project automation (https://just.systems)
betterleaks = "1.4.1"          # Next-gen secret scanner with active verification (https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks)
trufflehog = "3.95.9"          # Local deep secret scan CLI (matches CI TruffleHog scanner version)
syft = "1.48.0"                # Multi-language SBOM generator for CycloneDX format (https://github.com/anchore/syft)
grype = "0.116.0"              # Vulnerability scanner for SBOMs (https://github.com/anchore/grype)
"ubi:anchore/grant" = "0.6.8"  # License compliance checker for SBOMs (https://github.com/anchore/grant)
# 1password-cli is omitted here to fall back to the Homebrew-managed `1password-cli@beta` global installation, which is required for `op environment`.
# 1password-cli = "latest"

# ============================================================================ #
# TASKS                                                                        #
# ============================================================================ #

[tasks.lint]
description = "Read-only fast lint (CI-shaped hk check; skips slow cov, secrets, doc gens)"
run = """
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export HK_SKIP_STEPS="${HK_SKIP_STEPS:-pytest-cov,betterleaks,gen-docs,gen-toc}"
hk validate
hk check --check --no-stage --all --fail-fast --no-progress
"""

[tasks.test]
description = "Canonical full project pytest suite (does not replace `just test` smoke)"
run = "uv run pytest"

[tasks.cov]
description = "Slow coverage verification (pytest-cov / hk --slow profile)"
run = """
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
uv run pytest --cov=src/git_cg --cov-branch --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered
"""

[tasks.security]
description = "Optional local SBOM + license + vulnerability verification"
run = """
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
syft . -o cyclonedx-json=bom.json
syft . -o syft-json=bom.syft.json
grant check bom.syft.json --dry-run
grype sbom:bom.json --fail-on high
"""

[tasks."test:cli"]
description = "Test the git-cg CLI scaffolding (Zero-Plaintext via 1Password SDK)"
run = "uv run python -m git_cg.main --help"

[tasks.pre-commit]
run = "hk run pre-commit"

[tasks."docs:build"]
description = "Build the Zensical documentation site locally"
run = "uv run zensical build --clean"

[tasks."docs:serve"]
description = "Serve the Zensical documentation site locally with live-reload"
run = "uv run zensical serve -a localhost:8082"

[tasks."setup:brew"]
description = "Install system-level dependencies required by the project"
run = "brew bundle --file=Brewfile"

[tasks."eval:promptfoo"]
description = "Evaluate and red-team GitOps commit generation, then sync to Opik"
run = """
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
npx promptfoo eval -o promptfoo_results.json
npx promptfoo redteam run -o promptfoo_redteam_results.json
uv run python scripts/sync_promptfoo_to_opik.py promptfoo_results.json
uv run python scripts/sync_promptfoo_to_opik.py promptfoo_redteam_results.json
"""
